scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @planetfall/shared" "npm run dev -w @planetfall/server" "npm run dev -w @planetfall/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @planetfall/shared && npm run build -w @planetfall/server && npm run build -w @planetfall/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @planetfall/shared && vitest run --configLoader native --no-file-parallelism
